name: Habits of Highly Effective People
excerpt: The Habits of Highly Effective People include proactive behavior and seeking mutual benefit.
notes: The Habits of Highly Effective People include being proactive, beginning with the end in mind, prioritizing important tasks, thinking win-win, seeking first to understand then to be understood, synergizing, and continuous self-improvement.
context_summary:
- Includes proactive behavior.
- Encourages beginning with the end in mind.
- Promotes prioritizing important tasks and seeking mutual benefit.
